mergeStrategies.copy: installer owns whole file; whole-file sha256
mergeStrategies.full-file-override: overlay replaces a core file; whole-file sha256
mergeStrategies.generated-block: installer owns one marked block; block-scoped hash only
mergeStrategies.append-fragment: installer owns one named appended fragment; block-scoped hash only
mergeStrategies.manual-only: tracked for awareness; never written by installer

hashScopeRule.runtime-mutable: tool mutates the file at runtime; install seeds from template on first run and never overwrites after; preflight + compare skip hash checks; reported as outcome 'runtime-mutable'
hashScopeRule.validation: REJECT any generated-block/append-fragment entry carrying a whole-file contentHash

manifestSchema.depotRevisionBinding: every managed VC file records depotRevision; drift preflight fails if headRev differs
